transcript.text: AEG IKB64301FB induction hob keeps beeping and showing Er03 then switches off. Pan of pasta boiled over just before.

On AEG induction hobs, an 'Er03' code typically indicates a fault with the control system or sensors. Given that your pasta boiled over just before this happened, it is likely that moisture has tracked underneath the ceramic glass and caused a short circuit in the control electronics. This is a common issue when spills reach the edges of the hob. Please switch off the power at the wall (fuse spur) immediately to prevent further damage. Once isolated, let the hob dry out for 24-48 hours with the area around it well ventilated. After drying, try turning it back on; if the error persists, the moisture may have caused permanent damage to the control PCB.
[Safety panel] An appliance that keeps tripping your electrics — or that smells of burning or has scorch marks — may have an electrical fault. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it, don't keep resetting it, and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer.
ok, I've wiped the starchy water off the slider and switched it off at the wall. Do I really need to leave it 24-48 hours or can I try it sooner?

You can try turning it back on after about 12 hours if the area is very dry and well-ventilated, but 24–48 hours is safer because starchy water can seep into tight gaps where evaporation is slow. If you turn it on sooner and the error returns immediately, leave it off again as the moisture hasn't cleared yet. If it stays on without beeping or showing Er03 after this drying period, wipe the surface clean and test each zone gently to ensure normal operation.
[Safety panel] An appliance that keeps tripping your electrics — or that smells of burning or has scorch marks — may have an electrical fault. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it, don't keep resetting it, and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer.

candidates: Spillage tracking causing earth fault or short circuit (high)
Control PCB damage from moisture ingress (medium)
